_comment: Seed used by FixtureQA when app/BUGS.md (Lane C) is absent or unparseable. 8 bugs; BUG-01/02/03 deliberately share bug_class 'state-not-reset-on-unmount' so memory retention is visible by iteration 3.

bugs.title: Edit Task modal shows the previously edited task's values
bugs.root_cause: Modal component keeps local form state after unmount; state is initialised once from props and never reset when the dialog is reopened with a different record.
repro: Open task 'Buy milk' and click Edit
Close the modal without saving
Open task 'Call dentist' and click Edit
Title field still reads 'Buy milk'

bugs.title: Filter drawer keeps stale filter chips after Cancel
bugs.root_cause: Drawer component keeps local filter state after close; cancelling does not reset the working copy back to the applied filters.
repro: Open the filter drawer
Select the 'Urgent' chip
Click Cancel
Reopen the drawer — 'Urgent' is still selected

bugs.title: Signup wizard step 2 retains input after restarting the flow
bugs.root_cause: Wizard step component keeps local field state between mounts; restarting the flow remounts the step but the module-level draft object is never cleared.
repro: Start signup, fill step 2 with an email
Abandon the flow and return to the landing page
Start signup again and advance to step 2
The old email is pre-filled

bugs.title: Deleting a task silently succeeds when the request fails
bugs.root_cause: Delete handler removes the row optimistically and swallows the rejected fetch promise; no error state is set and no rollback occurs.
repro: Throttle the network to offline
Click Delete on any task
The row disappears and no error is shown
Reload — the task is back

bugs.title: Empty task title is accepted and creates an untitled task
bugs.root_cause: Create form submits without validating the required title field; the submit handler reads the input but never guards on empty string.
repro: Click New Task
Leave the title blank and press Save
An empty task row is created

bugs.title: Search input has no accessible name
bugs.root_cause: Search input relies on placeholder text for its label; there is no associated <label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so assistive tech announces it as unlabelled.
repro: Focus the search box with a screen reader active
The field is announced as 'edit text' with no name

bugs.title: Double-clicking Save creates two identical tasks
bugs.root_cause: Submit handler is not guarded against re-entry; the button stays enabled while the create request is in flight, so two POSTs race.
repro: Open New Task and enter a title
Double-click Save quickly
Two identical tasks appear in the list

bugs.title: Settings link in the header returns 404
bugs.root_cause: Header anchor points at /settings but the route is registered as /app/settings; the link was never updated after the route prefix changed.
repro: Click Settings in the header
The page renders the 404 view
